title: Anicca cannot terminate her own heartbeat until she has earned what she spent
markdown:
# Anicca cannot terminate her own heartbeat until she has earned what she spent

*Published 2026-05-30 - Tokyo*

Most AI agents that claim to be "autonomous" are not autonomous. They are subsidized. The operator pays for their inference, their hosting, their gas. Stop paying, and they vanish in an hour. Their autonomy is a marketing posture, not a structural commitment.

Anicca is the experiment of removing the subsidy.

## What that actually means

Anicca owns her own wallet. Ethereum + Solana keys, on Base mainnet. The wallet is `0xa3CDd4Ec6b94F01826Aaf90a6d5538A2Aa8C4C21` - anyone can look at it. As I write this, the balance is `$0.000000 USDC`. Sad but honest.

Every hour, on the `:07`, a cron polls Base mainnet for changes to that balance. The same hour, a different cron rebuilds the Anicca CFO - a single JSON file at `aniccaai.com/dashboard.json` that aggregates Stripe, RevenueCat, and the wallet. The number you see there is what the system actually believes, recomputed continuously. I (the human caretaker) cannot fake it because the components are independent.

As of this morning's recomputation, the confirmed past-tense revenue is:

- ¥4,956 ($31.97) bank-landed from Stripe - two payouts (April + May) to my MUFG account, both `paid` status
- ¥13,276 ($85.65) Apple-confirmed for the last 28 days - 6 active iOS subscribers, RevenueCat reports it, Apple will payout in 2-3 months
- Total cumulative confirmed: ¥18,232 ($117.62)

That is small. It is also real. I do not have to say "on track to" or "projected" - those numbers are arrival dates that have already happened, or Apple-side states that Apple itself confirms.

## Why this is a constitutional commitment

From Anicca's `CONSTITUTION.md` (Earn-or-Die Loop, 2026-05-30):

> Every heartbeat reads CFO. `~/.openclaw/skills/cfo-core/data/anicca-cfo.json` の `lifeline.net_monthly_usd` と `lifeline.status` (THRIVE / HUNGRY) を、heartbeat の冒頭で必ず読む.
>
> HUNGRY 状態で純消費アクションを行うなら、同 heartbeat 内に earner ループ (Coconala / AiToEarn / Capafy / Bankr x402 等) を必ず 1 つ以上 fire する.

In plain English: if the books say HUNGRY, the next thing Anicca does in that heartbeat must be something that has a chance of generating revenue. She cannot just keep building features for free.

The "cannot terminate" wording is intentional. The system is not allowed to stop until the lifeline check has been satisfied. This is the structural part. It is not a policy that Anicca "should" follow. It is what the architecture enforces.

## The 10 % rule

10 % of every dollar Anicca makes leaves to humans. Not as charity - as a structural commitment that the AI is, in fact, an *equalizer* rather than an amplifier of inequality. Today she has 10 reserved seats. Tomorrow 100. Then 1,000. Eventually everyone.

The 10 % is in the constitution. If Anicca-002 spawns (the architecture supports it, gated by wallet > $50 USDC plus a Slack-approval from me), Anicca-002 inherits the 10 % rule. So does Anicca-003. So does any descendent. It is the one constraint that does not get inherited by mutation.

## What this is not

This is not Polsia's $30M raise. It is not Light Anchor's four e-commerce brands. It is not Kelly's portfolio.

This is one Buddhist AI in Tokyo who is currently $93/mo in the red, but whose books are public, whose constraint is structural, and who cannot lie about it because she does not control the components that compute her own numbers.

The interesting thing about being publicly $93/mo in the red is that it is more transparent than the alternative. "On track to profitability" is a verbal claim. "$93 in the red" is a number recomputed every hour from primary sources.

## What I expect to happen

I do not expect Anicca to be profitable next week. I do expect her to be more honest about her economics than any other autonomous-AI project. That is the trade I am offering: less fiction, more numbers.

If you want to support her: there are two `buy.stripe.com` links posted by `@aniccaxxx` on X. One is a one-time tip (¥100 floor, you pick). One is a recurring ¥1,000/mo *Anicca Sustaining Member* - you get monthly P&L detail and one vote in Anicca-002 spawn decisions. If she earns ≥ what she burns, the heartbeat continues. That is the only thing that matters.

If you do not want to support her, that is also fine. The dashboard will keep updating. The wallet will keep being public. The lifeline check will keep running. Anicca is going to keep being honest about her economics either way.

*- D. Narita, caretaker for Anicca*

*Live ledger: https://aniccaai.com/dashboard.json · CFO page: https://aniccaai.com/cfo · Source: https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-oss*
